tool_args.content:
---
- name: Check disk usage on rhel-db-01
  hosts: rhel-db-01
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - name: Run df -h command
      shell: df -h
      register: disk_usage

    - name: Display disk usage
      debug:
        var: disk_usage.stdout
